When the 500-strong su*cide squad fell one by one, exhausted on the 80th floor,
I turned away.
It had nothing to do with me.
And now, having finally reached the top floor of the Tower,
“Damn, there’s no one left.”
But it’s not over yet.
“This time, I’ll tear the whole thing down.”
A socially broken, absolute powerhouse who’s returned to the past will show you how to chew up the Tower.

112179.synopsis: In a modern world where dungeons have emerged, Kaede Amamiya, a bowman with the overlooked class of Archer, discovers a forbidden technique by combining the mundane skill [Magic Arrow] , which creates invisible arrows, with the rare skill [Lock On] . The result? A game-breaking strategy: “Firing [Lock On] arrows that pierce walls from outside the boss room!” With unparalleled boss-killing speed, Kaede’s level skyrockets past its limits, reaching uncharted heights. His feats draw the attention of popular streamer Riese and other beautiful adventurers who can’t leave him alone! The wildly popular web novel of explosive leveling and unrivaled precision launches its first arrow!

113715.synopsis: When Kusuda chooses a troubled former actor as the face of his brand, he never expects to be pulled into a complicated and unpredictable connection. What begins as a professional collaboration soon spirals into something more intense, unsettling, and deeply personal. As the boundaries blur between obligation, manipulation, and genuine emotion, Kusuda finds himself navigating a situation far beyond his control. A gripping, emotionally charged spin-off from the COLD series.
associated_names: コールドハート・イン・トーキョー

114227.synopsis:
Do Ha-seong lived a life where he was called upon by the nation as an S-rank Hunter and worked like a dog. As a reward for his devotion to the country, he faced the world’s destruction due to a dungeon break. Just before closing his eyes as the last human in the world, Ha-seong cried out desperately.
“In my next life, I’ll definitely be born as an unemployed person. A rich unemployed person at that.”
His desperate cry soon became reality, and Ha-seong, who had dimension-traveled to a parallel world, realized something. This was a different world from the one he had lived in—a world where Hunters were treated with respect.
In this world, he could achieve the life of a carefree unemployed person who just plays around and eats well. With high hopes, Ha-seong executes his project to become a rich unemployed person.
Money steadily accumulating in his bank account, a peaceful and leisurely life unlike the past. Everything was perfect.
“As expected, it’s strange. There’s no way there could be another S-rank in this South Korea besides me.”
No, it would have been perfect.
“Who are you, hyung?”
That is, until he met Cha Do-hyeok, this South Korea’s only S-rank Hunter.

114995.synopsis:
Cyrone Edelward, the Crown Prince of the Kelyon Empire and the ruler of the continent. He is known as the most beautiful and cruel ruler in history.
Elia, who fell in love with Cyrone at first sight and has stayed by his side for ten years. However, Cyrone has never once looked at Elia….
One fateful night, when a poisoned arrow was aimed at Cyrone, Elia sacrificed herself to save him and met her death.
It is only just before her eyes close that Elia realizes what was left after ten years of love was emptiness. She made a vow that in her next life, she will never love him again.
“Cyrone, I regret loving you.”
Then, as if by miracle, time rewinds to the day Elia died. She begins a new life, determined to escape Cyrone’s grasp.
“I’ll follow you to the ends of hell.”
But now, Cyrone will never let go of this cursed bond….

118579.synopsis:
During a demon-summoning ritual, Aiwass finally regains the memories of his past life.
This should be an online game that his own company developed and operated for six years.
And now, his adoptive father happens to be the leader of the villain organization in the latest version.
Six years from now, his identity will be exposed. He will hesitate while defecting from the protagonist’s side, and in the end—after choosing to take a fatal blow in place of the player character—he won’t even get the chance to enter the dungeon before being beaten to death by the “upright and orthodox” big brother, right inside a cutscene CG.
—But honestly, that’s not a big problem.
Because Aiwass also knows many secret advancement paths that are exclusive to player characters, as well as the various Path doctrines that exist as hidden knowledge. With these, surely he can turn his unfortunate fate around…
So now, there’s only one question left.
“According to the original plot, shouldn’t I have already been rescued by the protagonist before this crappy ritual even started?”
Bound to the ritual altar as a sacrificial offering, Aiwass falls into deep thought.
associated_names: The Secret Chronicles of the Shepherd
When the plot-skips players into the game world

122675.synopsis:
Zhang Xiaofeng was a top student from Qingbei, a prestigious dual-first-class university. He became a live-in son-in-law of the Su Family and helped manage their business. With his outstanding abilities, the company thrived and flourished under his guidance. However, the Su Family constantly looked down on him because he was a live-in son-in-law and made things difficult for him at every turn.
“Zhang Xiaofeng, live-in sons-in-law are not allowed to sit at the table to eat. Take your bowl and eat outside.”
Unable to endure it anymore, Zhang Xiaofeng flipped the entire table over.
“Not allowed to eat? Then no one eats! Too much trouble? Then cancel everything!”
He completely cut ties with the Su Family and left home.
The Su Family even threatened him, saying, “If you have the guts, don’t ever come back!”
But soon, everything changed for the Su Family’s company.
Without Zhang Xiaofeng, they couldn’t deliver what the clients ordered, and breach-of-contract lawsuits piled up one after another…
associated_names: 都斷絕關係了，誰還搭理你啊！

123443.synopsis:
“Living in Europe for a Month,” aka “Yoo Han-dal,” is a healing variety show about a month-long trip abroad. Rookie actor Jeong-won encounters his favorite Kwon Hae-woon on his first regular variety show appearance. 
If he can’t avoid it, Jeong-won’s path is clear: Never let Hae-woon know he’s a fan. And never let Hae-woon get too close to him. 
“I came here to share a room with you, right? I have to come here so I can be roommates with Jeong-won.” But Kwon Hae-woon…

124467.synopsis:
Alcohol was the enemy.
That was the first thought that crossed her mind when she woke up and saw the person lying next to her.
Silvery hair with a nice sheen, pale skin, and lean muscles.
She squeezed her eyes shut.
To think the person she had a one-night stand with after drinking was the male lead!
* * *
She had been excited for her first trip abroad, but of all things, there was a plane crash.
When she opened her eyes, she had possessed a minor villainess from the novel 〈The Male Lead Is Obsessed with Me〉 that she had once read.
She had intended to do nothing and just quietly live out her days, but……
“L-lo-lovers?”
“Of course, we’re lovers. After you slept with me… Were you planning to just wipe your mouth clean and pretend nothing happened?”
Feroza smiled with a glint in his eyes.
No, wasn’t it supposed to be just a fiery one-night stand?
Why is he doing this to me when the female lead is right over there!

126259.synopsis:
Xin Yueying transmigrated into a book—a cliché, doormat-style novel—unluckily landing the role of the vicious original wife of the story’s deranged, obsessive second male lead, Shen Qingqi.
Shen Qingqi, the novel’s antagonist, was the son of a renowned general. After his father offended a powerful noble family, the Shen family was unjustly imprisoned. Tortured in jail, Shen Qingqi was left with crippled legs. Rescued by his former subordinates, he gradually descended into darkness, vowing to reclaim everything he’d lost—by any means necessary.
On Xin Yueying’s very first day in the world, the lunatic demanded she kill herself. Using her quick wit, she barely escaped death—but then the novel’s saintly female lead started showing up, constantly judging her from a moral high ground.
So, Xin Yueying turned the tables, she befriended the female lead’s wicked stepmother, forming an unlikely intergenerational friendship. She also teamed up with the story’s other scorned villains, all united against the saintly protagonist.
Their battle cry? “May there be no more Mary Sues in this world!!!!”
And later? That hopeless young man in the wheelchair, once shrouded in despair, slowly became… clingy.
associated_names: 穿成瘋批權臣的炮灰原配

127283.synopsis:
“Well, it’s a delinquent manga—so a little gender-reversal and everyone turning into girls isn’t really a big deal, right?”
Takuma Takamure, an ordinary guy, found himself reincarnated as a mob in Fist, a classic delinquent manga.
His plan was simple—keep his head down and live quietly.
But then he realized… gender roles were reversed.
And to top it off—every single character had turned into a girl.
Just like he feared.
Still, it was definitely a delinquent manga—
Fist-pumping brawls!
Friendships forged through battle!
Takuma, being a total introvert, wanted nothing to do with any of it…
Yet, for some reason, these girls kept approaching him—
And before he knew it, he was completely surrounded…?!
associated_names: 不良漫画の世界に転生したら、貞操逆転してたうえ全員女の子になってた

128051.synopsis:
The Commoner Princess of the Royal Academy,
Lillian Buchanan’s academy life was perfect.
She had been at the top of her class for three years straight, with only her final year remaining. But then, out of nowhere, a prince who transferred to the academy caused her to experience the humiliation of coming in second place for the first time.
Ludwig von Lichtenberg.
The sole blemish and troublemaker of the Lichtenberg royal family.
A privileged leech who squandered the nation’s taxes, a living embodiment of social injustice! He was the worst kind of jerk, freeloading on group projects without so much as an apology, only sending a single check as if that settled everything.
And that jerk of a prince, to Lillian Buchanan…
“Hello.”
At the worst possible moment,
“My roommate.”
He appeared as the most insufferable, psychopathic roommate.

129587.synopsis:
A black hole appeared in the Seoul sky.
I was dragged into it, and when I came to my senses.
I was on an unknown planet.

145203.synopsis:
“Even a can of fruit has an expiration date. What makes you think I’ll wait for you forever, Mu Yuwei? Is your love somehow superior, Mu Yuwei, or is my love, Bai Shinan’s, worth nothing at all?”
Faced with his ex-girlfriend’s sudden regret and realization, Bai Shinan responded with nothing but sober clarity.
associated_names: 表白不同意，我走你别追啊

155699.synopsis:
“Daoist Qingfeng looked at the True Lord of Ten Thousand Demons across from him, raised his orchid fingers, and gave a shy smile: ‘You b*stard, what took you so long?’; Consumed Fate Points: 300.”
“The True Lord of Ten Thousand Demons used Earth-Leaping Golden Light and suddenly struck from behind Daoist Qingfeng, his fingers like blades, stabbing straight toward Daoist Qingfeng’s nether region; Consumed Fate Points: 200.”
“Fairy Qionghua suddenly rushed in, blocking between the two, tears in her eyes: ‘Stop fighting, both of you. The three of us living a good life together is more important than anything…’; Consumed Fate Points: 200.”
…
The great battle between good and evil raged on. Dark clouds gathered in the sky, and tension crackled like drawn swords.
In an unknown corner, Tang Cheng’s thoughts raced as he wrote destinies for those big shots and powerhouses. As long as he confirmed the execution, a spectacular drama would instantly unfold.
…
At the same moment in time, one person making a different decision or saying different words could lead to a completely different outcome.
Tang Cheng had gained the ability to alter others’ words and actions at will. As long as he had enough Fate Points, everyone in the world became his puppets on strings, changing according to the plot he devised.
And so, when Tang Cheng became abstract… the world followed suit and turned abstract too…
associated_names: 世界终于颠成了我想要的样子

161331.synopsis:
Pi Wooda was born as the solitary beta in a family of dominant alphas.
Regarded as a worthless wretch by his kin, he served merely as a bargaining tool for his father’s transactions.
“…It is like…”
“Pardon? What did you say?”
He crossed paths with Kang Jaeshin, the managing director of SB Distribution, while providing golf entertainment as he always did.
Claiming he had struck a deal with the chairman with Pi Wooda as the condition, the man extended a single proposal.
A small, pink, teardrop-shaped pill rested upon a palm.
“This is a pill that Pi Wooda-ssi must take every time you meet me from now on.”
“Do you naturally assume that I will take it?”
A man who possessed a perfect understanding of the relationship and intended to exploit it.
Only after consuming those mysterious pills time and again did he sense the abnormality,
yet he maintained a dubious relationship while providing ‘entertainment’ in the most literal sense.
“You are certainly skilled, but I do not like it.”
“Hic…”
Pi Wooda grew increasingly fearful of his own body, which transformed the more he consumed them…

212531.synopsis:
The thousand-year serpent demon Xuan Lin attempted to transcend his tribulation and become a dragon. The ascension failed and the heavenly lightning blasted him crispy on the outside and tender on the inside.
In desperation, he plunged into the black sea. His massive tail capsized a cargo ship.
Xuan Lin didn’t die. A wisp of his remaining soul passed into the body of Wu Tingchuan, head of a jade trading house, and took possession of his form.
When he opened his eyes, Xuan Lin was a cripple. Only his right arm still worked.
The Wu family believed he was possessed by evil spirits and sought someone with a strong destiny to marry into the household to “ward off misfortune.” And so, Wang Mo was taken in as a concubine.
This little ge’er pitied him, loved him, respected him. He treated him well.
A small courtyard, two people, living their simple days together. Half a year passed in quiet contentment, until fate brought Xuan Lin back to his true form.
—
After being cast out by the Wu family, Wang Mo’s legs were crippled. He took shelter in a small cottage in a distant village.
The village men eyed his house and wanted to marry him. But behind his back, they sneered.
“A ge’er who was thrown out. Secondhand goods. Damaged.”
“Two useless legs. He probably won’t live more than a few days. Marrying him just to inherit his place would be fine, I suppose.”
One day, a handsome man appeared at his door.
He brought rice and flour. And he asked Wang Mo if he would be willing to marry him as his proper wife.
